topics.headline: Senators criticize Treasury ownership-reporting exemption
topics.summary: Senators Grassley and Whitehouse criticized Treasury for exempting 99 percent of entities from the prior beneficial-ownership reporting requirement to FinCEN.

topics.headline: Justice Department has not appealed firearms ruling
topics.summary: The administration has yet to appeal a firearms ruling from the previous week, leaving gun-control groups concerned and Second Amendment advocates hoping the Justice Department is standing down.

topics.headline: Elon poll shows Cooper ahead in North Carolina Senate race
topics.summary: An Elon University poll gives Roy Cooper 53 percent of likely-voter respondents and Michael Whatley 42 percent in the North Carolina Senate race.

topics.headline: Third person dies at New Jersey detention center
topics.summary: A Guatemalan immigrant detained at Delaney Hall in Newark suffered a medical emergency and died after being hospitalized, according to the report.

topics.headline: Midwest neighborhoods face flooding and more rain
topics.summary: Floodwaters entered homes in Indiana and Ohio as severe storms struck the Midwest, with some areas preparing for additional rain.

topics.headline: Hawaii faces hurricane watch as tropical storm forms
topics.summary: Tropical Storm Lala has formed in the Pacific, and a hurricane watch was issued for the Big Island. The National Hurricane Center forecasts rain beginning late Friday along with high winds and dangerous surf.

topics.headline: Wholesale inflation eases as gas and food costs fall
topics.summary: Wholesale inflation fell last month as gas prices reversed part of their Iran-war increase and other costs cooled. The report describes this as a possible sign of lower consumer inflation ahead.

topics.headline: Putin visit to disputed islands draws Japanese protest
topics.summary: Putin visited disputed Pacific islands claimed by Japan, which calls the four southernmost islands the Northern Territories. The visit drew a protest from Tokyo.

topics.headline: Low Danube flow shuts Romania nuclear plant
topics.summary: Heat and a sharp drop in the Danube River level forced Romania to shut its only nuclear plant. The Cernavoda plant supplies 20 percent of the country's electricity and is not expected to restart within the next 10 days.

topics.headline: Zambian president votes while seeking another term
topics.summary: President Hakainde Hichilema cast his ballot in Lusaka as he seeks a second term.

topics.headline: Iran asserts control over Strait of Hormuz
topics.summary: Iran says it fully controls the Strait of Hormuz and rejects US claims of dominance over the waterway.

topics.headline: WHO chief warns about severity of Ebola outbreak
topics.summary: The WHO chief says the Ebola outbreak is on track to become the deadliest ever. The outbreak was declared on 15 May and has caused more than 2,000 deaths, with thousands more reported cases.

topics.headline: WhatsApp tests optional on-device scam alerts
topics.summary: Meta is rolling out a limited beta of WhatsApp Scam Alert, an optional feature using on-device machine learning to flag suspicious messages.

topics.headline: Microsoft combines Copilot apps and drops features
topics.summary: Microsoft is merging its consumer and business Copilot apps while removing AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and the Mico character.

topics.headline: Report considers possible Anthropic IPO valuation
topics.summary: A report raises the possibility of a $2 trillion valuation when Anthropic goes public, with revenue growth fueling hopes for the listing.

topics.headline: White House may add open models to AI framework
topics.summary: Sources told WIRED that open models may soon be included in an updated White House AI framework. The report describes the administration as continuing to grapple with AI regulation.

topics.headline: User reports Claude Code auto-continue option
topics.summary: A Claude Code user reports seeing an option to automatically resume a session after the usage limit becomes available again.

topics.headline: DeepSeek Harness enters developer preview
topics.summary: A community post describes DeepSeek Harness as an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI, with an architecture built around plugins and powered by Cordis. The post says the harness is in developer preview.

topics.headline: MCP Memory appears in Hacker News submission
topics.summary: MCP Memory is listed as agent memory using Google's OKF and SQLite FTS5.

topics.headline: Developer shares Worklog and KnownPitfalls.md workflow
topics.summary: A developer describes a Worklog and KnownPitfalls.md workflow and says it helped them navigate model inconsistencies and regressions.

topics.headline: Developer records coding-agent mistakes in a repository file
topics.summary: A developer reports keeping MISTAKES.md in the repository and adding a CLAUDE.md instruction to log what happened, the root cause, and prevention.

topics.headline: Claude Code user asks about isolating agents
topics.summary: A user asks about isolating Claude Code agents that can access the filesystem and shell, expressing concern that a working directory does not limit that access.
